name: sol-advisor
description: Codex-native architect workflow with dashboard-switchable model roles (OpenCodex combos) plus an explicit opt-in, user-visible Luna task lane, with primary-session verification and acceptance.

interface.shortDescription: Orchestrate with Sol, use combo-routed Terra or opt-in Luna tasks, and verify the accepted diff.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor gives Codex two explicit delivery modes: the Sol combo (combo/sol-advisor-sol) keeps architecture, decomposition, verification, and acceptance in the primary session; the native mode uses a separately installed Terra combo role (combo/sol-advisor-terra) and a fresh Sol reviewer, while the opt-in Luna mode creates user-visible Luna tasks on the Luna combo (combo/sol-advisor-luna) through the Codex app task tools (list_projects, list_threads, create_thread, wait_threads, read_thread, and send_message_to_thread) and keeps review, corrections, PR authorization, and dependent-stack ordering in the primary session. All three roles resolve through OpenCodex combos, so the concrete upstream model is selected in the OpenCodex dashboard, not hard-coded.
defaultPrompt: Use Sol Advisor's native lane to build this feature, verify it, and obtain the fresh Sol review before completion.
Use the Luna task lane only when I explicitly authorize it; keep primary review and acceptance in this task.
